description: Redevelopment of site to provide a part three and four syorey building (Block A) fronting Witley Gardens containing 2 x 1 bed flats, 19 x 2 bed flats, 4 x 3 bed flats  and flexible 131 sqm commercial floor space (A1, A2,A3 and B1 Use Classes)  and a five storey building (Block B) fronting Grand Union Canal containing 9 x 1 bed flats, 17 x 2 bed flats, 5 x 3 bed flats and a flexible 175 sqm commercial floor space (A1, A2, A3 and B1 use classes) at ground floor level (56 private market units and 2 commercial units in total), the provision of 37 car parking spaces (6 disabled spaces) with access via a proposed private  off Witley Gardens, integrated refuse and cycle storage spaces, private amenity spaces and a public amenity space (following the demolition of the existing building on the site)
